**Is your feature request related to a problem?**

A description of the problem. Ex. "I'm always frustrated when [...]"
If this is related to an existing issue, link it here.

**Proposed solution**

A clear description of what you want to happen.

**Alternatives considered**

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Additional context**

Any other context — how this fits with existing commands, relevant spec
sections, or how you'd expect to use it.
